Full Statement: Work Based Learning CF

Domain 1
Core Standard 1: Students will be able to assess personal skills, abilities, aptitudes, strengths, and weaknesses as they relate to career exploration and development.
Research multiple career pathways related to the field of interest
Analyze personal characteristics, abilities, knowledge and skills needed for career success in chosen career pathway
Evaluate personal characteristics, abilities, knowledge and skills needed for career success in chosen career pathway
Re-evaluate career pathway plan to determine appropriate postsecondary educational options

Domain 2
Core Standard 2: Students will be able to understand and apply the personal qualities that affect success
Choose ethical courses of action
Evaluate feedback to improve job performance
Demonstrate a positive customer/client attitude
Utilize appropriate etiquette for various occasions
Analyze discrimination laws and give examples of discrimination
Utilize effective communication and interpersonal skills
Maintain confidentiality and integrity
Demonstrate information, communications, and technology literacy

Domain 3
Core Standard 3: Students will be able to understand workplace safety and workplace practices
Identify causes of accidents and apply safety procedures to prevent accidents
Develop characteristics of professionalism
Collaborate effectively with team members (classroom or the workplace)
Demonstrate an eagerness to learn new responsibilities or improve current responsibilities
Exhibit initiative in learning new skills and improving workplace skills
Summarize emergency preparedness plans for chosen career pathway
Examine workplace regulations, health and safety guidelines and inspections for chosen career pathway
Analyze licensure requirements for facilities and employees in chosen career pathway

Domain 4
Core Standard 4: Students will be able to develop strategies for an effective transition from school to career
Prepare a formal search, application and interview using the latest trends.
Demonstrate personal accountability and work productivity
Develop skills to give and receive constructive criticism
Exhibit leadership and responsibility in the professional setting
Demonstrate critical thinking and problem solving in the professional setting
Evaluate feedback to improve job performance and create professional work habits
Create a five year career goal plan

Domain 5
Core Standard 5: Students will evaluate their own career portfolio and pathway plan

Prepare and update a career portfolio based on a career pathway plan, which will includes a resume, sample cover letters, letters of recommendation, examples of work and technical skills, internship or work experience summaries, validation of work/internship experience, industry certifications, documentation of extracurricular and community service activities, and awards
Complete the training agreement document with signatures from the employer, internship coordinator, parents, and student
Create a training plan (based on content standards) in collaboration with the employer, teacher, and parents that include work-based learning goals and content related standards
Create an evidence based presentation portfolio
